free_parameters.name: batch
free_parameters.why: single batch is enough; the target decision is per head dimension and does not depend on batch size

free_parameters.name: heads
free_parameters.why: single head is enough; the decision is reached per call and does not depend on the number of heads

free_parameters.name: seq_len
free_parameters.why: the witness contains no sequence length; 64 is the smallest context used by the block-sparse path and yields one top-k block

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: the block-sparse kernel is fp16-only; dtype does not affect the integer head-dimension assert

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the random tensors so repeated runs are identical

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: selects the single block_sparse pattern entry; the target decision is independent of which head index is used

free_parameters.name: pattern
free_parameters.why: selects the block_sparse branch that contains the limitation; the witness identifies that path

mocks.reason: pycuda is not installed and needs a GPU; block_sparse_flash_attention imports it but never uses it before the target assertion
submodule imported by block_sparse_flash_attention solely to configure a CUDA context, which is unavailable on this CPU-only host
SourceModule is imported at module load but kernel compilation is never reached before the target assertion
flash-attn is a GPU-only optional dependency and is not installed; the block_sparse path does not call it
precompiled CUDA extension is not shipped in the repository; only convert_vertical_slash_indexes is imported and the block_sparse path never calls it

hooks.name: minference_namespace_shim
hooks.purpose: driver loads the real entry module from minference/modules/minference_forward.py through a namespace package object, skipping minference/__init__.py which imports unrelated optional and GPU modules; no function on the call chain is replaced

hooks.name: import_time_cuda_arange
hooks.purpose: minference_forward.py creates a module-level tensor with device='cuda' at import; driver maps torch.arange to CPU during import only, and that LAST_Q_MASK tensor is unused on the block_sparse path
